name: mission_init_objectives
description: Mission::InitObjectives constructs the global HUD sensor tracker and registers its shutdown routine with the CRT atexit provider.
known_limits: Tier C only; the local VC5SP3 COFF byte-comparison target currently fails to compile because the full HudSensorTracker header path pulls MFC common-control provider types that need additional VC-era provider setup.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly at 0x417350 calls HudSensorTracker::ConstructGlobal and tail-jumps HudSensorTracker::RegisterGlobalOnExit; HLIL has no warnings and shows the same call sequence.

The native smoke seeds the global HudSensorTracker with non-default values, calls Mission::InitObjectives, and verifies the global constructor path restored the tracker defaults before shutdown cleanup.
